score_domain: raw_margin; output_margin=True throughout training/QA/Optuna/WP/apply, no sigmoid or feature scaling

selection_order: strict MC signal mass window / data outside the same window
mass_selection.interval_policy: cuts: min inclusive, max/abs_max exclusive; pT [low, high); training mass uses strict inequalities and excludes both endpoints

signal.truth_policy: applied by native/previously prepared MC source, not re-evaluated by sampler

background.comparison: mass < low or mass > high; both endpoints excluded

mc_range_selection.bounds: inclusive at both ends; rows removed, surviving values unchanged
mc_range_selection.efficiency_scope: conditional on the same frozen MC feature ranges applied to all domains
mc_range_selection.shape_policy: range selection only; no distribution matching, reweighting or Winsorization

reference.source: bounded selected finite-feature reconstructed MC signal sample
reference.group_definition: source file/tree and PV surrogate; not a producer collision ID

limitations: Finite reference quantiles do not guarantee a full-population coverage fraction.
A rectangular feature range does not enforce a joint-density or shape match.
The MC-derived preselection acceptance needs independent MC for a final physical efficiency.

vertex_convention: Producer stores SV-PV; directly use X/Y/ZDecVtx for cosPA/radius/ct, matching spectrum GeneralHelper.hpp
checks: Full global and pT synthetic workflow/report/cache
Native XGBoost/HIPE raw margins and expit closure
Strict signal/background mass windows including endpoints
Negative margin/config/efficiency arrays, finite held-out eff=1 endpoint
Unbounded storage null floor retaining all finite in-scope margins
Old model/NPZ/scored domain rejection including missing metadata
Five actual features only in feature distributions, correlations, importance
Score histograms cover all train/test tails without [0,1] assumptions
Existing DSCB, curve rendering, statistics, systematic, MC and ROOT contracts

visual_review.findings: Five physical-valued features; cosPA near 0.999-1; negative and >1 margin axis; labels and curves readable

physics_limits.meaning: Software acceptance does not establish model goodness of fit or a final physical WP
